justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief figural carving with curvilinear elements, and both include something readable as an anthropomorphic face or figure, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. B presents a strictly organised composition \u2014 a plaited interlace border enclosing stacked rectangular panels containing a mounted rider, animals and standing figures \u2014 whereas A shows large, unframed mask-like faces spread over irregular natural boulder surfaces with no border, panels, riders or animals.
